item.title: Fred again.. Announces First Ever India Tour: ‘We Are Beyond Excited to Come’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we bring you the latest updates from the world of music. Today, we're excited to share some news about a rising star in the industry. Get ready to groove, India! Fred again.. is coming to town!"
[Short music clip]
Host: "The producer has just announced his first-ever tour in India, with three dates lined up in December. He'll be performing at Leisure Valley Ground in Delhi NCR on December 5th, Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai on December 9th, and NICE Grounds in Bengaluru on December 13th."
[Short music clip]
Host: "Fred again.. is thrilled about the tour and says he's received an overwhelming response from fans in India. He's also partnered with Monkey Shoulder to offer affordable ticket prices, starting at ₹1,750 and ₹3,500, which is approximately $18 and $37 USD."
[Short music clip]
Host: "What's more, these shows will be Fred's only live performances this year, featuring music from his debut album 'Actual Life' to his latest 'USB' album. And, if you're a fan, don't miss out – these are the only dates currently scheduled for his 2026 tour."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Tickets go on sale June 30th, so mark your calendars! We can't wait to see Fred again.. bring his energetic live show to India. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
